mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the cleaned address against the handset was most worthwhile: it showed the problem was directory exclusion, not a spelling error.

leastWorthwhile.text: Loading the crate onto the repaired trolley felt slightly anticlimactic because I expected it to reach the door in that action.

surprise.text: The handset read the address correctly but still rejected it; the signed receipt later made that contradiction concrete.

arbitrary.text: Powering the bell felt unclear at first: it was the only offered combination, and its connection to the crate was not yet apparent. Eli opening the gate explained it afterward.

continue.text: Yes. The contradiction between the directory and the physical clinic gives me a reason to see what happens next, and the trolley repair was satisfying.
